title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Excellence
text:
At Nestlé Health Science, we believe that nutrition, science, and wellness must merge, not collide. Here, we embrace the intrinsic connections of these three pillars, harnessing their collective strength to empower healthier lives. Our broad product portfolio includes renowned brands like Garden of Life®, Nature's Bounty®, Vital Proteins®, Orgain®, Nuun®, BOOST®, Carnation Breakfast Essentials®, Peptamen®, Compleat Organic Blends®, and more. We also have extensive pharmaceutical expertise, offering innovative medicines that aim to prevent, manage, and treat gastrointestinal and metabolic-related diseases.
 
 
At Nestlé Health Science, we bring our best for better lives. Our people are challenged to bring fresh, diverse views and make bold moves to empower healthier lives through nutrition. We know brilliant ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. Here we embrace the entrepreneurial spirit and collaborate with teams that champion focused and forward thinking. We are committed to fostering professional growth and celebrating the achievements of our people along the way. We offer dynamic career paths, robust development, opportunities to learn from talented colleagues around the globe, and benefits that support physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing.
 
 
Join us to innovate for impact and reimagine the future of health and nutrition for patients and consumers.
 
 
The Senior Manufacturing Excellence Manager is responsible for the development, alignment, and execution of a factory-wide performance improvement strategy. The role acts as the center of expertise and key driver for Nestle Continuous Excellence (NCE) and Industrial Performance activities in the factory.
 
 
This position will be onsite in the Eau Claire factory.
 
 
**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Directly reporting to the Factory Manager, the role is accountable for NCE Implementation Strategy, Continuous Improvement and Industrial Performance responsibilities within the factory.
* Responsible for development, competence building, and health of Industrial Performance systems & routines, including Labor utilization studies
* Accountable for data reliability, SAP BOM/Master Data, planning rate reviews, Asset Intensity and utilization systems, Nestle Standards for Manufacturing Performance
* Leads development of Strategic plan (OMP) and improvement strategy in the Factory
* Ensures the right cascading of priorities and measures from the Market to the factory
* Defines and embeds NCE projects and initiatives into the Factory objectives and align Factory Leadership Team towards the plan
* Establishes and drives effective Factory governance to ensure that NCE implementation contributes to delivering business results
* Supports Factory competency building plan that ensures NCE is developing autonomy at all levels of the organization.
* Stewards, trains, supports and coaches the Factory Leadership Team and Local Leadership Teams in Manufacturing competencies (e.g. GA, FI, TPM 7+4) behaviors and applicable manufacturing standards
* Develops competency of Local Leadership Teams and Factory Leadership Teams, supporting them to apply methodologies to improve and sustain results (e.g. all NCE methodologies, Value Added Activities, Workload studies, etc.)
* Conducts, sponsors and/or coaches specific projects to support results improvement around priorities established by the Factory
* Understands and ensures together with Factory Cost Controller an overall competence of Costing Standards for Manufacturing
* Collaborate with Market Excellence manager within a Market/Category to drive NCE

**EDUCATION:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Engineering, or a related field required. In lieu of a degree, 10 years of relevant professional experience will be considered.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification desired

**EXPERIENCE:**- 8+ years in a manufacturing or continuous improvement environment, required.
- Food or CPG experience preferred which includes:

* 2-3 Years’ Minimum years of direct production/maintenance floor experience
* 2-3 Years’ Experience working with factory management/leadership team
* Success in Leading & Developing cross functional teams
* 2-3 Years’ experience of project management, loss intelligence, & advanced problem solving
* 2-3 Years Minimum years in Goal Alignment/TPM/Lean implementation

**SKILLS:**

* Strong knowledge of digital tools including Power BI, SAP Master Data, DMO and other visualization tools/data analytics experience preferred
* Strong leadership in cultural change management & managing multiple complex priorities and business connections
* Ability to understand/learn new manufacturing processes and quickly identify their challenges and areas of opportunity
* Experience in developing Line labor standards, Budget preparation/review, and line capability/speed studies
* Advanced knowledge of TPM
* Strong Problem-Solving capabilities
* Demonstrated track record of leading changes in difficult environment
* Demonstrated track record and competence on TPM and Lean and/or World Class Manufacturing (WCM) methodologies and implementation.
* Cultural change agent working with hourly operators and senior stakeholders
* Project Management capabilities

Salary: $144,659.70 to $189,943.00 per year
 
 
Bonus Eligibility: Yes
 
 
The pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at top of range.
 
 
Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at https://www.nestlejobs.com/nestle-in-the-us-benefits
